column1: # The frozen section scope of the Web IDL census: authored input, one
# line-opening heading id per line, case-exact.
# Ruling R-P1 gives the Bikeshed profile a sectionScope switch and
# docs/PROMISE-PACKAGE-PLAN.md resolves it against this file rather than
# against a list in Lean, so widening the scope is a data review. Widening it
# is a contract change: test/contracts/webidl-census.contract.md section 2
# freezes these five ids, their spans and their digests.
# A listed id that is not a line-opening heading with that exact id fails
# generation; a listed section that governs no row fails generation; and a row
# that lands outside every listed section fails generation.
